Silhouette: Horse-height equine frame with the horse's neck and body, a short thick donkey head with long ears, a short upright mane, thin limbs on small hooves. Host frame: the horse sets the outline, body size and overall frame. A single creature that combines a donkey and a horse. Head of the donkey, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: body with horse neck shape and body; head with short thick donkey head; ears with long donkey ears; mane with short donkey mane; tail short-haired at the base and longer below; limbs with thin donkey limbs; feet with small donkey hooves; coat texture with coarse donkey coat; behavior may follow one parent; plain coat, no stripes or spots. Coat texture flows along the body outline. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (dry woodland): larger ears and longer tail for shedding heat. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.
